source: PARAPHRASE: Virginia Tax, Income Tax Withholding Guide for Employers (2614086 Rev. 10/26), pages 5, 11, 21-22
standardDeductionSunsetNote: The standard deduction increase to $8,750 ($17,500 on annual returns) is scheduled to sunset after taxable year 2026 and revert to $3,000 / $6,000 under current law (guide pages 5 and 21).
preTaxNote: PARAPHRASE/ASSUMPTION: Guide page 11 states Virginia conforms to the federal definition of income subject to withholding; 401(k) and Section 125 are modeled as reducing Virginia wages under this conforming provision.
notes: PARAPHRASE: Virginia Tax, Income Tax Withholding Guide for Employers (2614086 Rev. 10/26), page 21: T = G x P - [$8,750 + (E1 x $930) + (E2 x $800)]; floor T at 0. Standard deduction in withholding formula is flat $8,750 for all filing statuses (married filers claim E1=2 for self and spouse).
Rounding rule (guide page 22): Round annual tax W to nearest whole dollar, then divide by pay periods P.
No local earned income tax in Virginia.
